Flood Insurance Data

Flood insurance cost by ZIP code

Type a ZIP code to see what existing NFIP flood insurance policies on single-family homes there typically cost a year, and how many policies that rests on.

Median: existing single-family primary-home NFIP policies, premium plus fees, in force on August 31, 2026; shown only where 25 or more priced policies exist. Policy units: every NFIP policy unit with that ZIP, all building types. ZIPs exactly as FEMA recorded them on policies; a ZIP with only a policy or two in a county may have been entered with the wrong county. Not a quote.

Why one ZIP's figure is not your price

FEMA prices each building from where it is (distance to the coast, rivers and other flood sources, and how high the ground sits), how it is built (foundation type, first-floor height) and what the policy covers (coverage amounts and deductibles).

For the full picture where you live, open your state and county.

Source: FEMA OpenFEMA NFIP Policies v3; rules from floodsmart.gov. How we check them.
